old.power: Panic Check: Ask “Is this right?” If anyone answers “Yes,” discard this card and ignore the consequence.

new.power: Panic Check: Ask “Is this right?” If anyone answers “Yes,” discard this card and ignore the consequences.

old.power: The Meta: Cancel a move that is “too fun” on the grounds that it isn’t optimal.

new.power: The Veto: Cancel a Move that is “too fun” on the grounds that it isn’t “optimal.”

old.power: Internal Scream: If a die rolls off the table, you must freeze until someone tells you it's okay.

new.power: Internal Scream: If a die rolls off the table, you must freeze until someone tells you it’s okay.

old.lore: Blödsinn is not a mistake. It is a state.

new.lore: BLÖDSINN is not a mistake. It is a state.

old.power: Reality Check: If the table laughs, your roll succeeds automatically.

new.power: Reality check: If the table laughs, your roll succeeds automatically.

old.lore: They exist to interrupt pure panic.

new.lore: They exist to interrupt rule panic.

old.power: Edit: Physically cross out one word on a Stage Card. It is now forever removed.

new.power: Editor: Physically cross out one word on a Stage Card. It is gone forever.

old.power: Validation: Play to approve a move that the “Rules Lawyer” rejected.

new.power: Validation: Play to approve a move that the ‘Rules Lawyer’ hates.

old.power: Declaration: Read the Anti-Rule aloud. No discussion allowed.

new.power: Declaration: Read one Anti-Rule aloud. No discussion allowed.

old.power: Focus: If everyone looks at you, +1 to your roll.

new.power: Focus: If everyone looks at you, +1 to your Roll.

old.power: Critique: Claim this is “Bad Design,” reroll your die.

new.power: Critique: Claim this is ‘Bad Design.’ Reroll your die.

old.lore: When the table stalls… invoke an Anti-Rule.

new.lore: When the table stalls... invoke an Anti-Rule.

old.power: Stop: Any player may play this to stop trying to win. They are now telling stories.

new.power: Stop: Any player may play this to Stop Trying to Win. They are now just telling stories.

old.power: Comfort: Protect an Actor from a “Blödsinn” check.

new.power: Comfort: Protect an Actor from a ‘Blödsinn’ check.

old.power: Presentation: Stand up and explain your move like a CEO. If they buy it, it works.

new.power: Presentation: Stand up and explain your move like a CEO. If they buy it, it succeeds.

old.power: Doubt: Challenge a “correct” move. There is no correct move.
old.lore: Remove the illusion of a “correct” move.

new.power: Doubt: Challenge a 'Correct' move. There is no correct move.
new.lore: Remove the illusion of a 'correct' move.

old.power: Deflect: Shift the consequence of a bad roll to the Game Designer.

new.power: Deflect: Shift the consequence of a bad roll to the 'Game Designer'.

old.power: Define: You decide what another player's card “really” means.

new.power: Define: You decide what another player's card *really* means.

old.power: Interpretation: The rules mean whatever the group decides they mean tonight.

new.power: Interpretation: The rules mean whatever the group decides they mean right now.

old.lore: Leave the emergency handle named “Please tell me the correct move” unused.

new.lore: Remove the emergency handle marked "Please tell me what the correct move is."

old.power: Shift: Force an Actor to change their MOOD to “anxious.”

new.power: Shift: Force an Actor to change their MOOD to ‘Anxious’.

old.power: Tip: Instantly change the Quest Goal by 1/2.

new.power: Tip: Instantly change the Quest Die value by ±2.

old.lore: Tell a story connecting Mood → Stage → Quest.

new.lore: Tell a story connecting: Actor -> Stage -> Quest.

old.power: Game Over: End the game if everyone at the table feels “fluffy” (relaxed/confused).

new.power: Game Over: End the game if everyone at the table feels 'fluffy' (relaxed/confused).

old.power: Victory: Win the game instantly if you shout “BINGO!” for no reason.

new.power: Victory: Win the game instantly if you shout 'BINGO' for no reason.
